description: Spine and curved ribs, bleached clean. A Palehusk wore it badly, and a Glowbone would have lit it up.
lore: Sold by the cage, priced by the rib, and that is where the trade does its small daily cheating. A rib is the best stock going for anything long and slightly bent — netting needles, comb teeth, a splint to bind a cracked shaft — and the flat of a big one makes a better knife scale than any wood. So count them at the counter. The seller counts thirteen a side out of habit, the buyer counts what is actually there, and the gap between those two numbers has bought a great deal of drink on that road.

[[characters/54bead23|Osric]] counted one out loud, all the way to the end, in front of the man selling it. He was advised, evenly and by everyone present at once, never to do that again. He still does not entirely see why, and the road has decided that is the best thing about him.
gm_notes: The counting joke, and Osric's counting habit turned outward. Rib prices are the batch's plain-commerce baseline.
